displayTitle: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back Read-Along Storybook
synopsis: The Rebellion faces its darkest hour in Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back. Fully illustrated with gorgeous images by Star Wars artist Brian Rood, this epic storybook also includes a CD with word-for-word narration, music, and character voices. Follow along as Luke Skywalker trains with Yoda to become a Jedi and defeat the fearsome Darth Vader.
title: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back Read-Along Storybook
